serviceTerms.title: Terms of service
serviceTerms.description: What to know about placing orders, drop-off, payment and cancellation at WashGo.
serviceTerms.intro: Please read before using the service. Eligibility, deadlines and amounts are checked by the system when you act. Check your Order details for the latest information.
serviceTerms.footerNote: You can reopen these terms at any time from the footer.

booking.title: Orders and drop-off
booking.body:
Creating an order reserves a compartment; it does not confirm drop-off or payment. Use the locker and compartment assigned to your order, place your items inside, close the door and confirm drop-off using your PIN or QR code.
Drop off within the deadline applicable to your order. This depends on system settings; the current 30-minute reminder is the default reference. Prices may change after the merchant records the actual weight and any surcharge.

cancellation.title: Cancellation eligibility and fees
cancellation.body: You may cancel only your own eligible orders and must provide a reason of 1–500 characters. Review the cancellation quote, estimated refund and outstanding fee before confirming. The quote is an estimate; the system recalculates the fee when you confirm.

late.label: Awaiting drop-off, past deadline
late.value: A configured percentage of the service amount before discounts.

deposited.label: Dropped off in locker
deposited.value: A configured percentage of the service amount before discounts.

collected.label: Collected and weighed
collected.value: Cancellation requires a recorded actual weight. The configured percentage applies to the final amount after discounts and confirmed surcharges.

processing.label: Washing has started or later
processing.value: Cancellation is unavailable. Refunded orders cannot be cancelled again.

cancellation.configNote: Default system settings: 30% for overdue drop-off, 30% after drop-off, and 50% after collection and weighing. Administrators can change rates and deadlines; these defaults do not guarantee the current fee. The fee confirmed for your cancellation applies.

refund.title: Refunds and return of cancelled items
refund.body:
Refunds are based on verified payments minus the cancellation fee. If a refund is due, the system creates a pending refund request; cancellation does not mean money has already been returned.
Outstanding cancellation fees must be paid before collecting your items. Cancellation does not automatically release an occupied compartment or confirm collection. Follow your order's item location and return instructions. An existing refund request that has not been rejected must be handled before cancellation.

pickup.title: Payment, collection and code security
pickup.body:
Collect only when the system confirms eligibility and payment conditions. Check Order details for the collection deadline and any overdue or storage charges. Keep your PIN and QR private; drop-off and pickup credentials serve different actions.
Confirm collection and door closure only after retrieving all your items. Locker operations in this version are simulated through user confirmation.

complaints.title: Incident reports and complaints
complaints.body:
For completed orders, report an incident within 3 days of the completion recorded in the order history. Reports require a description of 1–2,000 characters and 1–5 evidence images. Each order may have only one pending complaint.
Track the outcome in Manage complaints. Any compensation is determined during review; submitting a report does not mean it has been approved or paid.

orders.empty: You have no orders yet. Create your first order and let WashGo care for your laundry.
orders.noMatches: No matching orders. Try different filters.
orders.invalidResponse: Unable to read the order information. Please try again.
orders.detailsHint: View the services in your order details.
orders.noTimeline: No processing history has been recorded yet.
orders.pinNote: Keep your PIN private. The price and estimated time may be updated after the partner weighs your laundry.

cancel.title: Cancel order
cancel.note: Review the fees before confirming. The system recalculates fees when you cancel; deposited belongings remain secured until collected.
cancel.reasonTooLong: The cancellation reason must be at most 500 characters.
cancel.notAllowed: This order is no longer eligible for cancellation.
cancel.unknownOutcome: The cancellation outcome is unknown. Close this window and refresh the order to check before trying again.

payment.title: Order payment
payment.processingNote: Payment is available when the order is awaiting payment. WashGo confirms the price after processing and weighing, when applicable.
payment.waitingWeight: Waiting for the partner to weigh the laundry and confirm the final price.
payment.unavailable: Online payment is unavailable for the current order status.
payment.redirectNote: You will be redirected to the selected gateway to complete your payment securely.
payment.pendingConfirmation: The server has not confirmed payment yet. If you already paid, wait and check the status; do not pay again.
payment.uncertain: The payment request outcome is unknown. Check the status or contact WashGo before paying again.
payment.invalidResponse: The payment response is invalid. Please check with WashGo.
payment.missingOrder: No matching order was found for this payment return. Reopen the order payment details or contact WashGo.
payment.invalidMethod: Please select a valid payment method.

notificationNav.refundScope: Showing refund requests for the notified order.
notificationNav.shipperDescription: Assignment, collection/return reminders and delivery updates. Shipper task pages will be added later.

sync.legacy: Legacy record: available data may have been reconstructed.
sync.currentImages: Locker images show the current resource, not a historical photo.

tasks.description: Track and complete the collection and return tasks assigned to you.
tasks.searchHint: Enter a WashGo or merchant order code…
tasks.seeDestination: Open details to see the return locker
tasks.noAction: No delivery action is currently available for this order.
tasks.autoBox: The system selects a return compartment on confirmation
tasks.credentialHelp: Enter the task PIN or scan its QR to record delivery. Check the order and locker before confirming.
tasks.codeHelp: The system issues this PIN/QR for your current assignment. Reveal it when needed and do not share it.
tasks.codeUnavailable: The task credential is missing or has changed. Please refresh the task.
tasks.invalidPin: Enter all 6 digits of the task PIN.
tasks.wrongQr: This QR is invalid or does not match this order and task type.
tasks.collectCheck: I confirm the order, locker and compartment, and agree to record collection to the store.
tasks.returnCheck: I confirm the items are ready at the correct locker, and agree to record return to the compartment selected by the system.
tasks.checkRequired: Confirm the delivery information before continuing.
tasks.changed: The task has changed or been reassigned. Close and refresh to check it.
tasks.unknown: The delivery result is unknown. Do not resubmit; refresh to check or contact your merchant for verification.
tasks.invalidId: The task ID in the URL is invalid.

deliveryHistory.description: Review the collections and returns you have completed.
deliveryHistory.invalidUrlDates: The date range in the URL is invalid. Showing all dates; please select a valid range.
deliveryHistory.basis: Each collection or return counts as one delivery. Summary cards use the date range, independently of the selected delivery type. Order status is current; times use Vietnam time.

shipper.dashboardDescription: Track your assigned tasks and delivery results.
shipper.periodScope: Reporting period: {{from}} – {{to}}. Pending tasks reflect the current state; lifetime deliveries cover all time.
shipper.periodHistoryBasis: {{from}} to {{to}} · Vietnam time. Up to 5 latest events; each collection/return counts as one delivery.
shipper.noPeriodHistory: No deliveries completed in the selected period.
shipper.historyBasis: {{day}} · Vietnam time. Up to 5 latest events; each collection/return counts as one delivery.
shipper.noTasks: You have no pending tasks of this type.
shipper.returnLockerUnavailable: Return locker information is not available in this list.
shipper.profileDescription: Your personal details, vehicle and responsible store.
shipper.profileMissing: No Shipper profile is linked to this account.
shipper.profileMissingHint: The server could not find a Shipper profile linked to this account. Your signed-in account details are shown below. Ask your merchant or administrator to check your delivery profile, then select Refresh.
shipper.workHint: Your store manages work availability and merchant assignment. Operational status cannot be changed from this profile.
shipper.editHint: Email and responsible merchant cannot be changed. A plate is required for motorbikes and cars.
shipper.avatarHint: One JPG, PNG or WEBP image, up to 5 MB. Remove the current image to choose another.
shipper.changed: Your profile has changed. Close and reload before editing.
shipper.unknown: The save result is unknown. Close and reload your profile to check before submitting again.

validation.phone: Enter a valid phone with 9–11 digits, up to 20 characters.
validation.vehiclePlate: Plate: up to 20 characters; required and at least 4 characters for motorbikes/cars.

storage.title: Storage and redelivery
storage.customerHint: Track your items and request redelivery to a locker. WashGo will notify you after the items are placed in a compartment. Pay any outstanding amount in the order payment section.
storage.feeBasis: Fees show the current obligation for the entire order. Do not add history rows together. Reload to update.
storage.departBlocked: Dispatch is not available. Check the request, accepted quote and payment.
storage.confirmed: I have checked the details and confirm this action.
storage.confirmHint: Check the details before confirming. The system will check the current state again.
storage.simulation: Delivery confirmation is simulated using task credentials; it does not control a physical locker door. Confirm only after completing the corresponding handover step.
storage.legacyProof: Confirm only after verifying outside the system that the items are at the current shop. Enter the verification reference and reason; no handover date will be invented.
storage.confirmRequired: Please confirm that you checked the details.
storage.invalidPin: The PIN must contain exactly 6 digits.
storage.customerError: Unable to process the request. Close and reload, check the quote or contact WashGo.
storage.unknown: The outcome is unknown. Check the result first. If it is still unavailable, explicitly replay the same request. Do not create a new request.
storage.chooseLocker: Choose a return locker / Refresh quote
storage.quoteHint: The quote checks whether this station can receive your items. It does not reserve a compartment or take payment. Availability is checked on delivery. Cancel the previous request before changing stations.
storage.quoteExpired: The quote expired. Get a new quote.
storage.legacyCustomer: WashGo must verify this older order before redelivery. Please contact support.
storage.workStatusHint: You can switch between Available and Offline. You cannot go offline while assigned to an active task.
storage.statusBlocked: Your current status or active tasks prevent this change.

blocked.WrongStage: This task is not at the dispatch stage.
blocked.ProfileInactive: Your profile or account is inactive.
blocked.StaffStatusManaged: Your busy status is managed by the system and cannot be changed here.
blocked.ActiveDelivery: You have an active delivery task and cannot go offline yet.
blocked.QuoteChanged: The customer must accept a new quote.
blocked.PaymentRequired: Full payment is required before dispatch.

storage.historyHint: Storage and redelivery cycles for this order.
storage.frozenLockerFee: Frozen locker fees for this cycle
storage.frozenWarehouseFee: Frozen storage fees for this cycle
